items.title: Implement fix for reproduced failure
items.userSees: After dev_finish on a DEV story, the story is in REVIEW with a freshly minted currentReviewRound, a phase_transition process-event whose toPhase is REVIEW, and no event mislabeled TEST.

happy.desc: dev_finish on a completed DEV story routes through runStoryTransition: phase becomes REVIEW, a currentReviewRound is minted, and a phase_transition process-event with toPhase=REVIEW is appended.

adversarial.desc: dev_merge (the second registered bypass door) also routes through the orchestrator and does not write phase directly.

items.title: Serialize same-owner concurrent transitions with a per-story transition lock
items.context: Hold a per-story transition lock across read, gate, and persist in runStoryTransition so two concurrent same-owner DEV to REVIEW attempts cannot both act on the same pre-transition state and double-mint review rounds.
items.userSees: Two concurrent DEV to REVIEW transitions for the same story produce exactly one review round and one phase_transition event; the second observes the committed transition.

happy.desc: Two concurrent same-owner DEV->REVIEW transitions for the same story produce exactly one currentReviewRound and one phase_transition event.

adversarial.desc: The losing concurrent transition observes the committed post-transition state and does not re-mint a second review round.

auditLog.reason: Story-init reviewer flagged the mutex deliverable was untracked by the single generic checklist item; add it explicitly.
